name: Douglas County, WI
findings: Douglas County has 140 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 52 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Douglas County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Douglas County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 9 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
